Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with pain and
swelling of the left wrist. Imaging and physical examination clearly confirm a distal
radius fracture, and the treating team immobilized the wrist and arranged follow-up.
Over five visits the patient's course followed a typical pattern: pain and swelling
were managed with standard analgesia, the cast was checked and later removed, and
range-of-motion exercises were introduced as healing progressed. Visit frequency
tapered as the patient improved and grip strength and mobility returned toward
baseline. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained.
Causation relative to this collision is not yet clear and sohuld be reviewed once the
complete records are available. Billed services correspond to the documented visits
without repeated charges for the same procedures. Ongoing monitoring is recommended,
with a return visit if new or worsening symptoms develop.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
